assertions.name: alpha_required_is_convention_independent_by_construction
assertions.source: b = sqrt(d1*d2+1) with d1 = q^3/(q^2+1), d2 = -1/(q(q^2+1)); u = b*hbar^2; Q_A = m_e|q^2-2q-1|(q+1)/(2q^3). None reads z, so cos(alpha_eff_req) = Q_codata/(Q_A(1-u^2)) is the same target in both frames — which is what makes the C/D comparison fair rather than a comparison of two different targets.

assertions.name: D_frame_phase_residual_is_COMPARABLE_to_C_not_orders_worse
assertions.source: |gap_D/gap_C| = 0.89532612 at the proton anchor — the D-frame asserted phase is slightly CLOSER to alpha_required than the C-frame one. This probe was written expecting 'orders larger'; that assertion failed and the expectation is retracted.

assertions.name: the_c3_gap_is_1_over_u_cubed_amplification_not_a_large_phase_gap
assertions.source: cos(alpha_eff) differs C->D by 0.0006011538 relative; divided by u^3 that is 972.94833, against an actual |c_3(D)-c_3(C)| = 972.36255 — agreement to 0.06024 %. So c_3 = -974 is the ladder's own 1/u^3 = 1.6e6 amplifier acting on a 0.06 % cos difference, not evidence that D breaks the physics.

assertions.name: RETRACTED_neither_asserted_phase_reproduces_CODATA_at_N2
assertions.source: RETRACTED 2026-08-18. This asserted that both frames leave ~0.1 rad for c_3 because both gaps exceed 0.01. The gaps were measured against the PRINCIPAL arccos branch only, but cos is EVEN — the C phase sits on the NEGATIVE branch, with a true residual of 2.26e-5 rad (~5017x smaller). C DOES reproduce CODATA at N=2 to that residual, which under 1/u^3 amplification is exactly c_3 = -2.069. Kept as a recorded retraction rather than deleted, so the corpus shows the correction. Superseded by qbeta_eigenphase_branch_and_barodd_projection_probe.py.

description: Bean qou-cds1. Scores both Markov conventions against the phase the N=2 Q_beta ladder actually requires. alpha_required is convention-INDEPENDENT because b and u are built from the Hoefsmit couplings (d1 = q^3/(q^2+1), d2 = -1/(q(q^2+1))) and not from z — note d1 is numerically identical to z_D while being a different object, a coincidence this probe explicitly does not read as 'the Gram already uses D'. So the phase is the only convention-dependent input to the N=1 rung, and one fixed target scores both frames at both anchors. Records the residual each frame's asserted phase leaves for the c_3 rung to absorb, and that residual's cross-anchor drift. DERIVES NOTHING: proposes no phase, wires no value, settles no convention — alpha is asserted in both frames (probe_q_beta_operator_valued_N3.py:70) and derived in neither, which is precisely what cds1 is open on.
